title: The Layers That Matter in Networking

scenes.say: Ever wondered which networking layers you really need to know? Let’s break down the ones that matter most for interviews.
Layer two is all about MAC addresses and switches. Layer three handles IP addresses and routing. Layer four is where TCP and UDP ports live. Layer seven is your app layer—think HTTP and DNS.
Load balancers at layer four route by port and don’t care about the app protocol. Layer seven balancers can inspect HTTP and route based on app traffic.

scenes.question: Ping works but app port times out. Why?
scenes.right: The network path is fine. Something blocks or isn’t listening on that port—maybe a firewall or the app isn’t running.
scenes.say: Here’s a classic interview trap: If ping works but your app port times out, it’s not a network path issue. Something’s blocking or not listening on that port.
